title: SOL Systems Explorer Starter Kit
description: No-build interactive technical explainer starter kit for hardware startups, engineering consultants, technical marketers, industrial designers, and technical educators. Includes a live JSON system editor, mobile-friendly interactive system viewer, visual themes, component navigation, and single-file HTML export. This is a visualization and technical-communication template, not CAD, engineering simulation, a certified digital twin, or safety-critical engineering software.
